column1: Hierophant: Sr/Fr Dadouchos, your station and duties?
column2: My station is in the South to symbolize Heat and Dryness,

column1: My station is in the South to symbolize Heat and Dryness,
column2: and my duty is to see that the Lamps and Fires of the Temple are ready at the opening,

column2: to watch over the Censer and the Incense,

column1: to watch over the Censer and the Incense,
column2: and to consecrate the Hall, the Sodalii and the Aspirant with Fire.

column1: Hierophant: Sr/Fr Stolistes and Sr/Fr Dadouchos, will you please purify and consecrate the Hall with Water and with Fire.

Stolistes: I purify with Water.

The Dadouchos continues censing around the circle until they return to the East, traces a cross and circle in the air, then raises the Censer on high and says
Stolistes: The Mother of Darkness hath blinded them with Her Hair.
column2: The Father of Darkness hath hidden them under His Wings.
